question.text: Monitoring a PMS portfolio should include:

answer.text: Returns + Risk (standard deviation, beta, tracking error, VaR) + monitoring/rebalancing against target policy portfolio + Benchmark comparison + Client needs change

explanation.text: The Logic: Comprehensive monitoring covers benchmark comparison, monitoring and rebalancing the portfolio against the target policy portfolio, recognising changes in client goals or risk tolerance, and tracking source-backed risk measures such as standard deviation, beta, tracking error and VaR. The Trap: Returns-only monitoring is incomplete; risk measures and client-circumstance changes are equally important. Note: Source: NISM-Series-XXI-B Portfolio Managers workbook, p.173, p.175, p.289-293, p.370-374.
